purpose: Fallback formulas for rooms without an approved S/M/L layout; approved SVG layout takes precedence.

rules.preserveAsset: Never alter native SVG or component relationships.
rules.clearance: Keep entrance and movement axis unblocked.
rules.placement: Cluster by function and furniture mounting; avoid parallel rows of unrelated objects.
rules.furniture: Use verified recipe instances and asset IDs only. Do not add story objects.
